core_obligations: Closure of an irreducible set: the proof writes a putative separation of the closure and pulls it back to the irreducible subset, which gives assertions (1) and (2) (proof lines 1116-1125).

Existence through a maximal element: to show that every irreducible subset lies in an irreducible component, the proof applies Zorn's lemma to the family of irreducible subsets containing it, ordered by inclusion, and uses that the union of a totally ordered family of irreducible subsets is irreducible (proof lines 1125-1136).

Assertion (4): since a singleton is irreducible, the existence statement applied to a point gives an irreducible component through every point, so the space is the union of its components (proof lines 1137-1138).
Conclusion: the four numbered assertions of the statement (proof line 1138).
proof_roadmap: 把闭包的分裂拉回不可约子集，得 (1) 与 (2)。
对包含给定不可约子集的不可约子集族用 Zorn 引理（全序族的并仍不可约），得 (3)；单点不可约，故每点都在某个不可约分量中，得 (4)。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects the basic properties of irreducible components (author lemma at source lines 1102-1113, label lemma-irreducible): closures of irreducible subsets are irreducible, components are closed, every irreducible subset lies in an irreducible component, and the space is the union of its irreducible components. The proof (source lines 1115-1139) mirrors the connectedness lemma but with a Zorn argument in place of the common-point trick: it takes a maximal element of the irreducible subsets containing the given one, using that the union of a totally ordered family of irreducible subsets is irreducible (proof lines 1125-1136), and then applies the result to singletons for assertion (4). The list is the reference point for the chapter's later results on sober spaces and spectral spaces. H2.
